claims.claim_text: The 1978 BEFRS theorem gives rhat(sP3,tP3)=3(s+t-1) and the complete optimal star/triangle host family.
claims.support_summary: Original 1978 theorem PDF SHA256 b7af965c7eefa6ad427043cebe1c17d6a30a6c72e53ec3862814459df7ed9229; independently checked elementary upper bound.
claims.promotion_condition: Source-lock and independent full examination of published 1978 proof.

claims.short_name: Optimal hosts need not admit maximum-degree forest deletion
claims.claim_text: For c>=1 and N=s+t-1>c, G=cK3+(N-c)K1,3 is globally optimal for (sP3,tP3) but no set of maximum-degree vertices makes it acyclic; its feedback-vertex number is c.
claims.support_summary: Elementary pigeonhole and degree proof; 1978 optimality; exhaustive 239616 colourings and 246 edge-deletion witnesses on 20 small mixture cases.
claims.promotion_condition: Independent logical review; do not infer any counterexample to the original size Ramsey conjecture.

claims.claim_text: For independent k-set U, Δ(G)=D and H=G-U, χ'_l(H)<=D-2k implies χ'(G)=D. For pseudoforests with maximum degree r>=2 the bound D>=2k+max(3,r) suffices.
claims.support_summary: König colouring, residual list edge colouring, cycle-first leaf-restoration argument; 1280 deterministic constructive checks in conversation release.
claims.promotion_condition: Separate review or formalization plus source-controlled replay.

claims.short_name: Subcritical counterexamples must be Class II if joint bound holds
claims.claim_text: Conditional on the unproved J>=W-w2, any e(G)<=W-1 Ramsey host has e=W-1, Δ=w2-1, every max-degree deletion joint-extremal, and χ'(G)=Δ+1.
claims.support_summary: Vizing's bound and both vertex-deletion residual constraints imply equality and a Class II obstruction.
claims.promotion_condition: Prove or refute joint bound before removing conditional premise.
